## Services

- [UX/UI audit](https://vino-costa.com/services/ux-audit/): A rapid interface review + a polished report with a payment link.
- [Trial Week](https://vino-costa.com/services/trial-week/): A full-time week-long design sprint — the flagship offer.
- [Redesign](https://vino-costa.com/services/redesign/): Site → audit → design system → new design.
- [Monthly support](https://vino-costa.com/services/monthly-support/): All-inclusive startup design support.

## Portfolio

- [Roobinium crypto wallet](https://vino-costa.com/portfolio/roobinium-wallet/): A fail-safe wallet: onboarding, seed flow, multichain balance. Neon + glassmorphism, dark theme.
- [DeFi yield dashboard](https://vino-costa.com/portfolio/defi-dashboard/): Staking, liquidity pools, APY charts. Dense analytics without clutter, built for traders.
- [UFO Gaming game landing](https://vino-costa.com/portfolio/ufo-gaming/): A play-to-earn promo: cyberpunk art, tokenomics, a whitelist call to action. 2M+ visits at peak.
- [Lunar Labs crypto banking](https://vino-costa.com/portfolio/lunar-labs/): A mobile bank for crypto cards: transfers, limits, conversion. Premium UI, dark neon.
- [Rental tokenization (RWA on-chain)](https://vino-costa.com/portfolio/rwa-rental/): UX/UI for real-world assets on-chain: property listings, shares, payouts. Case breakdown.
- [NFT collections marketplace](https://vino-costa.com/portfolio/nft-marketplace/): Showcase, mint, auctions, creator profile. Focused on the art and fast gallery browsing.
- [DAO governance portal](https://vino-costa.com/portfolio/dao-portal/): Proposals, quorum, vote delegation. Transparent analytics for the community treasury.
- [Crypto startup identity](https://vino-costa.com/portfolio/crypto-identity/): Logo, token palette, guidelines and a set of launch marketing banners.
- [Exchange terminal UX audit](https://vino-costa.com/portfolio/exchange-audit/): A rapid review of a trading interface: heatmaps, a report and conversion recommendations.

## Projects

- [Cyberpunk UI Kit](https://vino-costa.com/projects/cyberpunk-ui-kit/): A personal library of neon components: tokens, glassmorphism, dark theme. A sandbox for the brand style.
- [Generative NFT avatars](https://vino-costa.com/projects/generative-avatars/): A pet project: procedural generation of cyberpunk portraits + a mint page for testnet.
- [A Telegram channel on Web3 design](https://vino-costa.com/projects/telegram-channel/): Breakdowns of crypto product interfaces, UX-audit guides, behind the scenes of sprints.
- [Figma token-sync plugin](https://vino-costa.com/projects/figma-token-sync/): A utility: export design tokens from Figma to CSS variables. A bridge between design and code.
- [A neon weather dashboard](https://vino-costa.com/projects/neon-weather/): A learning front-end: animations, glass cards, dark theme. Polishing micro-interactions.
- [A tutorial series on design sprints](https://vino-costa.com/projects/sprint-tutorials/): Videos and articles: how to take a startup idea to a clickable prototype in a week.

## Blog

- [Why a weekly design sprint beats a three-month contract](https://vino-costa.com/blog/weekly-design-sprint/): How short cycles turn an idea into investor-ready UI without a black box in the middle.
- [How a UX audit boosts conversion](https://vino-costa.com/blog/ux-audit-conversion/): What I check in an express interface audit and why it pays off faster than a redesign.
- [RWA on-chain: a rental design case](https://vino-costa.com/blog/rwa-onchain-case/): UX/UI for tokenizing real-world assets — a breakdown from structure to the deal screen.
- [Kaizen in design: continuous improvement](https://vino-costa.com/blog/kaizen-in-design/): How a method of small constant improvements is built into the weekly sprint.
